## What are you building?

Describe the page or workflow where the block would be used.

## What should the block help users complete?

Name the concrete outcome. Examples: compare projects, explain work history, or start a conversation.

## Required content

List the information the block must support. Include optional and repeated fields.

## Interaction and responsive behavior

Describe keyboard, mobile, loading, empty, or error behavior that matters.

## References

Link to a public example, sketch, or minimal reproduction if one exists.

## Adoption signal

- [ ] I plan to install this in a current project.
- [ ] I can test an early version in a clean consumer.
- [ ] I am exploring the idea and do not need it yet.
